title: Zeebe deployment rejection rules
description: One entry per rule Zeebe applies when a BPMN resource is deployed (doc/deployability/zeebe-rules.md). The checks themselves stay in code: packages/core/src/bpmn/zeebe-validate and crates/bpmnkit-compat/src/zeebe.

latestVersion.description: The Camunda version validateDeployable targets when none is given.

messages.description: Zeebe's message text, `%s` for a placeholder.

since.description: First Camunda version the rule applies to.

until.description: Last Camunda version the rule applies to, when Zeebe dropped it.

kind.description: static: structure only; feel: needs a FEEL parse or constant evaluation; context: needs other resources or broker state.

check.description: model: validateDeployable; xml: validateDeployableXml (the text, before parsing); context: only with a resolver; none: not decidable from one BPMN (see note).

coveredBy.description: An umbrella rule: the ids of the specific rules that report it.
